reviews.title: Do not use for anything personal
reviews.text:
After buying an iPhone duo, I decided to take notability for a spin. I’ve used it in the past on my iPad, but not for a long time. It was always a five-star app, the one star is because it’s taken my personal journalling entries and AI without my permission has made a quiz. Some of the questions are quite difficult to read because I’ve used no ability on and off for about five years for my personal journal. 

Absolutely disgusting. You should be ashamed of yourself as a company. 

I did not ask for this. All I did was log into the app and the first thing I see is AI reading all my notes without but my permission and then making a quiz. From what I can see, there’s no way of turning this off. 

When will companies understand that we don’t need AI in absolutely everything.

reviews.title: Holds your Notes Hostage!
reviews.text:
Once your storage is full, either in the cloud or your device, Notability starts putting your notes in local memory where you can’t get them in the cloud or your tablet. It’s literally in limbo! I’m sure a Computer Science grad can walk you through the multi day process AI had to explain to me to retrieve these files but I’m not a doctorate in cyber security. I’m an everyday businessmen, in tech no less, that simply needs access to my notes and can’t get to them.
I repeat, if you have a large quantity of important notes, don’t get this app unless you keep ICloud Sync off and manually email everything you want saved to yourself, because this app makes your notes inaccessible by keeping them in a state of ETERNAL ‘Still Downloading’ if you have the least bit of storage problems. 
And that’s on both ends btw. 
Even in the cloud and drives where they should’ve been stored I either don’t see them or it’s too complicated to access and send them back to the tablet where they’re manageable. 
In either case, I’d say everything else about the app is sublime, especially the very kind customer service reps who I have to frequent regularly for assistance. 
But again, if you’re a professional with a lot of notes, or even a few notes that use a lot of storage space, I pray for you.

reviews.title: Contacting customer support was a nightmare
reviews.text: I love using Notability for studying, but this ordeal was a rollercoaster. One of my notes disappeared. There was one option I could not try, which was to search iCloud Drive. There’s no option for me to search iCloud Drive within the app. However, when I searched for the note using my Mac’s Spotlight search, it showed that the file existed, but Notability wouldn’t allow me to open it. I emailed support, and it was an AI bot that couldn’t understand “there’s no option for me to search iCloud Drive,” even though I repeated myself multiple times, submitted images and a screen recording for proof. It responded a whole day later, asking if I found it. No, I did not. Thankfully, my laptop backs up automatically, and I was able to find an older version of the note, but I lost about 6 pages of work. Genuinely so upset.

reviews.title: A ridiculous amount of bugs when using an Apple Pencil.
reviews.text:
I am beyond disappointed that I even have to write this review. I have been a loyal Notability user for the past eight years, and I can confidently say that my recent experience with the app has been nothing short of frustrating. For an app that is specifically designed for note-taking and handwriting, it is embarrassing how poorly some of its most basic features function.

I recently started using a new Apple Pencil, which works perfectly fine in every other drawing and note-taking app I have tested. Yet, in Notability, it has been an absolute nightmare. Random areas of my screen suddenly become completely unresponsive to my Apple Pencil, making it impossible to write or draw in certain spots. Additionally, the partial erase feature frequently erases entire strokes instead of just the selected portion, completely defeating its purpose. Even something as simple as selecting and moving figures around the page results in excessive glitching, making basic editing tasks unnecessarily difficult.

These are not minor inconveniences. These are fundamental features that users rely on every single day. It is ridiculous that after eight years of using this app, I am now struggling to perform tasks that should be effortless. What makes this even more frustrating is that my Apple Pencil functions perfectly in other applications, making it clear that these issues are specific to Notability.

For an app that markets itself as a reliable, high-quality note-taking platform, this level of fun

reviews.title: Builds Dependability, Costs Money, Crashes Constantly
reviews.text:
10/11 Update: They’ve released an update but still haven’t addressed this glaring issue. 

Update 10/1: Can no longer resize images. If you click the corner of an image, it just grabs it and moves it around. What the heck Notability? How could you break such a simple thing. In fact, your release notes say you actually improved image resizing, but nope…

For an app that charges quite a bit for what it boasts to provide, the level of incompetence of the developers to avoid crashes multiple times a day and meet simple user feedback spanning years is incredulous.

Requests enumerated throughout forums online include, most critically: stability improvements. How they’ve gone so far in AI integration while still lacking basic stability is beyond reproach. 

Infinite paper: while they’ve said this is understandably difficult to integrate, it’s been a top request of dedicated users for years! Instead users have to resort to other apps for this feature.

“Keep downloaded” option. Nothing is worse than opening this app, no matter the device, to see all your notes missing. Does it even allow you to prioritize downloads for what you need? Of course not! So if you have years of school notes, it is going to start with the oldest and work its way to what you need now. 

The biggest problem here? The issues really start to build after you’ve become dependent on the app. So the developers don’t give a rats behind. They got your dedication and subscription so the issues the heaviest users enco

reviews.title: Used to be a solid app
reviews.text: I’ve used notability for many years.  Ever since they shifted to their own “cloud” the app has become irritatingly glitchy, but when you love something you stick with it and hope the glitches will eventually be fixed.  Up until a few months ago I had hundreds of notes in notability.  As of today I have less than 20 and I will be exporting those this weekend.  Yesterday a hundred page note just up and disappeared.  Not in recently deleted, not in any backup, not available on any other device that I connect to notability with.  Just like it never existed.  “Fin”, the AI support might be helpful if it asked for relevant info before leading one down a multi-email rabbit hole.  By email #5 it was repeating itself and giving nonsensical suggestions.  Used to be a fantastic product, but I’ll be abandoning this weekend for good and sharing my experiences with clients and others I know who value their data.

reviews.title: App deleted my work ALL OF IT
reviews.text: In the middle of using it to create a very detailed note that took weeks that had been opened and closed multiple times (was clearly saved) a cloud popped up and froze the screen. I don’t have it set to sync, I didn’t ask it to. I don’t have an absence of storage. I did everything right, and it deleted my entire note with no way to recover it. It’s just infuriating, and if I had been using that for school notes it could’ve been detrimental. So I ABSOLUTELY DO NOT RECOMMEND using this app for anything important that you don’t want to lose. Would be a phenomenal app if this weren’t a problem. This has happened twice now, both with notes that cannot be replaced without weeks of work.

reviews.title: Their new cloud removed over 2000 notes of mine!
reviews.text: Ive used this app for the past 6 yEARS. I LOVED IT! Thousands of notes from my masters and such valuable stuff of mien is on this app. I got a new iPad and signed into notability, something I’ve done dozens of times previously. This time, all my notes for the most part of just, missing? Why would this happen notability? Ive used iCloud for years, kept all my devices in sync, why am I missing all of my notes? I’m completely devastated. I need them back! Thank goodness I had the Google Drive backup, but they’re .not files and are unorganized. Even whatever is saved in iCloud Drive is not organized. Thanks notability for this major headache. This needs to be resolved before I start recommending apple notes, something I rather not use, to my friends, family, and students.

reviews.title: From Great to Unreliable. Support Doesn't Care.
reviews.text:
I've been a Notability power user for six years with over 5,500 notes. This app used to be great. I relied on it every day for my business and even built it into the system I teach my clients.

Now it's deleting handwritten notes while the note is open. I can literally watch my writing disappear. I've deleted and reinstalled the app, updated the app and iOS, closed background apps, and tried every fix I could find. Still happening.

Support has been worse than the bug. I got an auto-response, and when I tried to escalate, I got a canned email about signing into the wrong account and iCloud sync. Nothing to do with my issue. Then the ticket was closed and I was told replies aren't monitored. No real person ever looked at the problem.

Every year the bugs grow faster than the improvements. A note app has one job: keep what you write. It's gone from really good to really bad. Massive disappointment.

reviews.title: WORST Customer Service - They don’t respond to you! HORRIBLE
reviews.text: I have been trying to get through to someone from Notability for the past week and no one is answering my emails. I purchased notability prior to November 21, 2021. I purchased it on August 24, 2018 to be exact. I have an email chain showing proof of this. I was grandfathered in to the notability classic user status and for whatever reason I was removed from that and now I have only limited edits on notability. I was never supposed to have to pay yearly for notability because I was grandfathered in. I have email communication with Notability from 2023 proving this. It has gotten to the point where I have been emailing everyday to Notability for the last week explaining this and no one has helped me. I use notability on a daily basis. I had to re-purchase it in order to be able to use it for my job. I need to be refunded and restored back to my classic user abilities that I was grandfathered into, as I should not be paying yearly for this app. I have been asking for help and no one has been responding to my emails regarding this issue. ABSOLUTELY WORST CUSTOMER SERVICE. I have never dealt with a company where they do not respond to you. I will be contacting Apple regarding this as well because it is completely unacceptable.

reviews.title: Bad business
reviews.text: I paid for notability back when it was a one time payment and now this company refuses to honor that purchase and tried to get me to pay for a membership, or pay a now much higher one time fee to unlock features I’ve already paid for. I opened a ticket with their customer service and their agent took over a week to respond, was totally unhelpful, and closed the ticket without any resolution.

reviews.title: DO NOT INSTALL THIS APP
reviews.text: If you’re going back to school and looking for a notetaking app, don’t waste your time installing this app. With every update the issues get worse - with the newest version I can no longer resize text boxes and when I try to highlight text it just moves the box. I wish I had never put all my notes on here, don’t make the same mistake and get invested in an app that’s barely functional.

reviews.title: Keep losing date

reviews.title: Absolute garbage
reviews.text: Absolute trash, fix your app

reviews.title: Be ones useless when you can’t access older files, just spinning sync
reviews.text:
One of my favorite apps until the last few months where I can no longer reliably access all notes on my iPad. ,y iPhone syncs up fine. I have plenty of storage on iPad and ran all their tests and troubleshooting, this started about the time they made their own cloud to sync. 

Otherwise it does great at syncing recording of lecture to my notes and transcribing and ai summarizing. But when I’m on dr call or in person for my special needs son and I can’t access old note files from previous visit, it makes it practically useless. I’ve spent decent hours trying to figure it out. The backup is set only on iPad and appears to work. New files show up in backup for iPad, but not phone and new files on phone haven’t shown up,on iPad. I have notes going back several years I need access to, but it keeps trying to reload and I can’t just select one to force it to focus on it. 

I’d cancel my subscription but I can’t afford to lose what files I have. I wish they would just fix these known syncing issues, as I loved it before this mess. The fix online date is clear back in March, so they haven’t addressed since then.

reviews.title: Explain this
reviews.text: Explain this feature never work. I paid the highest subscription for this and never work. It’s always not available with any notes. Contacted them, and the answer is we recently fixed this problem. Obviously not.

reviews.title: Good app, incompetent tech support
reviews.text: I used notability without problems for years and it was great. However, one day in the middle of an important block of medical school I was locked out of my account. The notability tech support was utterly useless through countless mostly ignored emails and nearly impossible to get into touch with. I lost 5 years of notes due to their utter incompetence in helping me after this random and arbitrary lock out. I will likely continue to use notability with a new account but if you value keeping your notes over the long term or responsive tech support do not use notability.

reviews.title: Garbage app, will not sign me in
reviews.text: Set up an account online, tried to log into the iPadOS app, said my username or password were incorrect. Same credentials log me into the website in a browser on the iPad. Trying to log into the app using the Send Link option opens the website in a browser, does not log me into the app. What a waste of time. Then again, almost everything is on an iPad exception passive consumption.

reviews.title: Ruined by Upsells and Unnecessary AI
reviews.text:
I rarely write reviews, but my experience with Notability has gotten bad enough that I felt compelled to write one.

This used to be a great app, but it’s gotten progressively worse. I already pay for a subscription, yet I’m constantly hit with ads and pop-ups trying to get me to upgrade to an even more expensive plan. If I’m already paying for your app, I shouldn’t have to deal with ads every time I open or use it.

The AI features feel unnecessary, poorly implemented, and like an excuse to push more expensive subscriptions rather than actually improve the note-taking experience.

I’ve used Notability for a long time, but I’m done with it. Do yourself a favor and use Goodnotes instead.

reviews.title: Please bring back “Fill in the Blanks” “Mix and Match” “Flashcards” and “Auto”.
reviews.text: The new updated Learning method is horrible. Please bring back “Fill in the Blanks” “Mix and Match” “Flashcards” and “Auto”. I loved it so much, it really helped me learn, it helped me get 80% in my modules.

But no , they want you to pay for pro for that, which then i don’t see is the point even purchasing the app. Therefore its just another note taking app that u can realistically get for free. Super disappointing and unreliable.

reviews.title: Disappointing

reviews.title: It’s a ‘no’ from me
reviews.text:
Update: I have just received a response from the developers to my review (below), but it has taken them almost FIVE YEARS to respond.

There’s a lot to like about Notability (vs GoodNotes), and I even support the subscription model, but the deal-breakers for me are that 1) auto-backup turns itself off and then can’t be turned back on again without a lot of fiddling about, and 2) switching on iCloud (because auto-backup keeps switching off) deleted all my notes without warning. If only Notability could *reliably* back up my notes then it would be brilliant. Until then, I just can’t trust it.

reviews.title: Nowhere near as good as it used to be
reviews.text: Why the functionality has reduced is beyond me. The new feature of transcribing overlays on all your written notes, so it becomes useless. The summary side bar opens as soon as you open a new note. The recording function can no longer be moved from the main screen. Arghh! Infuriating changes and from someone who uses this app every day, that’s saying something.

Of course I was using a current version of the software, the one I paid you for. That wasn’t the problem. The problem was your software. I cannot believe that this has come as some kind of surprise to you.

reviews.title: What went wrong?
reviews.text:
Notability has been my go-to app for years. In fact, I bought an iPad every few years just as a platform for Notability.
When the subscription model came in, it became an overnight mess. Poor syncing, pointless changes, nagging adverts, and utterly pointless AI. Now every damn day I have to dismiss adverts telling me I need to spend more money.
I don't want a subscription, collaboration, AI, or system changes and vacuous artwork and fluff.
Please just let us Classic Users use the core system and don't keep messing it up.

When I got a new device for studying, there was no option I could see to sync between my devices, so I started a new set of notes separate from my previous 8+ years of app history. Just recently, I had the opportunity to sync. When I did, however, my past years’ worth of notes on my current device completely disappeared. When I contacted support, I only got an AI agent response – and having gone through the options, no chance to retrieve my lost notes.

A year’s worth of research, notes, and important material to my work, gone. I’m shocked at how downhill this app has gone besides this specific issue, with issues to do with crashing and relentless pop-ups, and I wouldn’t recommend anybody waste their money on this app.

reviews.title: Awful app
reviews.text: Incredibly unreliable, was so good for the first 2 years but now the app kicks me off all my notes and refuses to download any of my notes, constantly saying the note is downloading, causing me to lose all my notes within minutes of writing them.

reviews.title: Recurring Crashes - Do Not Use Web-Sync!
reviews.text: I have been using Notability for 4 years for school, side projects, drawing, creating games, and many other things. However, I cannot access any of it anymore. Although my syncing still works when I delete and redownload the app, the bigger issue is that when the new web-sync update came along and I tried using it, I constantly kept crashing. If you get notified to opt-in for web-sync, DON’T (unless you want to risk losing all of your notes). I also tried reaching out to support about this issue, and what did I get back? An AI response. The AI isn’t going to update the app or listen to my feedback, it’s just going to give the algorithmically best answer. That’s not what I want and that’s not why I’ve been paying the pro subscription for all these years. I need real human support, not this junk. I almost never write reviews, and I certainly would’ve given this a 5 star review any other day. But now I can’t access 814 notes that I’ve easily spent hundreds of hours carefully crafting together, all of my ideas I had written down, and now I have to restart some of my assignments for school. I don’t plan on taking this review down, but I will change my rating to 5 stars if they either fix their app or somehow there’s a way to fix the issue that I’m just not seeing. But if I end up fixing it before they can even roll out a proper update then you can be rest easy knowing I’m not giving this app a 5 star review. It was good while it lasted though, I hope the devs can actually fix the

reviews.title: Becoming progressively useless with each new update
reviews.text: Many apps fall into the trap of trying to add unnecessary bells and whistles to attract new customers or restrict usage of old customers in an attempt to extract more money. In the process they end up breaking what worked in the app and almost invariably customers switch to other competitive options. Notability is a prime example! Some of their early innovations were right on target, made it a great note taking app for researchers and students alike. Things were fine till it was a one time payment app, and as it switched to a subscription model its strengths were slowly disappearing. The innovations for the last couple of years have been gimmicky and absolutely useless. They are clueless of their customers’ needs. Other than adding bloat it has served no purpose to their core use, which was a great note taking app. With the latest round of updates where they are pushing to upload notes online has finally made the app encroach the territory where it is becoming completely useless as a notetaking app. It takes long to load, sometimes does not load notes when I absolutely need it. I was a paying customer, and even moved to their yearly subscription. Time to migrate to a different app which understands its purpose well rather than rots in the hands of some marketing/  product innovation team who are only trying to maximize revenue without understanding the purpose of their product…

reviews.title: Nearly double price increase!!!!!!
reviews.text: I find Notability a useful app that generally works very well. But an annual subscription increase from £9.99 last year to £17.99? You are, as we say in my neck of the woods, “havin’ a larf!” It is not as if there have been any notable improvements or additions lately - just quiz stuff that I doubt interests many. I shall be looking around for a software developer that does not rip you off.

reviews.title: Support is so bad, app is filled with many bugs.  Features are just broken. Many of them.
reviews.text:
I’m surprised this app is so highly rated.  I can only guess it’s based on making pretty notes in university not working professional notes. 

On top of the copious bugs I’ve found in 5 days or so, their support is some of the worst I’ve ever seen. I don’t know if it’s just an ai bot answering or someone who truly couldn’t care less. 

“I have encountered an issue doing this, which I suspect is based on this other thing, you can reproduce with 1/2/3. I can’t share the note with you as it contains sensitive data. Can you tell me the limit for this function” 

Answer - you may have run into an issue doing this other thing you exactly said, can you share the note with us? 

Thanks. 

“Sorry I can’t share it but you can reproduce it with 1/2/3”

Could you please make a video of the issue and send it to us? 

Lord above how hard is it when someone takes the time to tell you in detail how to reproduce a bug, to actually make an effort. Or to read a support email.  

This alone is enough reason not to pay for the app or subscription, add to that basically nothing works properly. 

Great pencil writing experience, absolutely abysmal everything else. Utterly useless / dumb ai support in 2026 doesn’t cut jt.

reviews.title: My exam notes all gone a week before my exam
reviews.text: I’ll be honest I’ve been using this app for 3 years and I thought it was great until out of nowhere it delete my study notes while I was on it trying to iCloud sync. I have enough storage and I tried all the troubleshooting steps provided by them and apple. But emailing them takes time which I don’t have as my exam is next week. I would recommend avoiding this app as after my subscription is done I don’t know if I can trust them with my files. Just imagine yourself in my shoes before downloading this app

reviews.title: Worst note-taking app ever
reviews.text: Used to be brilliant (used it for 3 years, with minimal issues). Around 2 years ago, a big update ruined it forever. Would repetitively sign me out and try and get me to pay, and would delete all my notes at will. Originally they would come back in a day or two. However, about 6 months ago now, they deleted all my 3 years of notes and I have never got them back on the app. Not worth re-uploading them all individually from drive (there’s thousands!!) so have moved onto another app. Complete rubbish and rubbish support too

reviews.title: Warning: glitches can cause notes to disappear
reviews.text:
I have been using Notability for many years and most of my notes are on here. I find it easy to make notes on this and I like the layout of the app.
However, recently whilst making notes, the app glitched and I found almost all of my recent notes, including the one I was working on, had disappeared. They weren’t in the recently deleted and they could not be retrieved from the iCloud backup. After doing some research online, I found this was a common problem among users - not sure why notability hasn’t fixed this yet.
Thankfully my notes that I lost weren’t irreplaceable but I would warn anyone using this for studying/important documents that it can very easily be lost and not retrieved. Moving on I’ll be using Goodnotes as documents seem to be more protected there.

reviews.title: Too slow and lags
reviews.text: Even though I purchased the premium version, it is lagging to convert the put in data to visible display. This is so annoying when talking lecture notes and you will fall behind. I will shortly make a video for youtube explaining this. Not recommended if you need to take lecture notes.

reviews.title: Einstelle
reviews.text: Ich spreche deutsch aber man kann es nicht von englisch zu Deutsch umstellen und die App funktioniert einfach nicht gut weil sie nimmt nicht alles wichtige auf was mein Lehrer sagt

reviews.title: What the hell
reviews.text: I cannot believe that, despite the app being amazing and seamless to work with, it switched me onto READ ONLY MODE?! In the middle of working. As a GCSE student, it’s just greedy. You want me to pay to write my notes? It’s ridiculous. Now, i cannot make edits to any of my hard work and notes I need for AN ENTIRE WEEK.

reviews.title: Split View muss zurück
reviews.text: Ich verwende die App seit 3 Jahren. Wirklich top bis nicht vor kurzem die Split View Funktion entfernt wurde. Ich verstehe nicht wieso man soetwas entfernt. Vorallem fürs lernen ist diese Funktion mit Abstand das praktischste gewesen. Was die Entwickler sich dabei gedacht haben ist wirklich fragwürdig. Noch nie etwas so dummes gesehen, das macht die App von einer guten zu einer unpraktischen. Sollte sofort wieder eingefügt werden.

reviews.title: Abo-Modell
reviews.text: Ich habe die App vor langer Zeit gekauft und sehe folglich nicht ein, dass ich regelmäßig auf verschiedenen Geräten bei App-Öffnung „Pop-Up-Fenster/ Banner“ sehe, die mich darauf aufmerksam machem, welche „kostenpflichtigen Neuerungen und Bereicherungen“ ich abonnieren könnte. Meiner Ansicht nach bestärkt dies die fehlende Bereitschaft, erneut Geld für Funktionen auszugeben.

reviews.title: Do NOT link Notability to iCloud!!!!!
reviews.text:
There is a rare glitch with Notability that can occur (has not only happened to me) where the Notability app deletes the Notability files saved in iCloud and then updates your Notability app to correspond with your iCloud account. This means all your local and iCloud Notability files are DELETED in the blink of an eye! How would I know this? Because I lost 4 years of my Maths Degree notes in the blink of an eye, 5 weeks before my final exams. Thankfully I had a fairly recent back up of my notes to Google Drive but had it not been for that I would have lost EVERYTHING. Go into the Notability settings and TURN OFF the link to iCloud and back up to something else instead! Apart from this glitch, which nearly gave me a mental breakdown, the app is very good and means you can have all your notes from every class you’ve ever taken on one device.

I have reduced my rating to 1 star as every time I open the app I am bombarded with popups asking me to ‘uograde’ to an annual subscription plan. STOP doing this - I paid for the Notability app years ago and I don’t want a subscription.
